message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to any incoming data or parsed arguments; argparse only performs basic type coercion with no range or validity checks.

No detected untrusted source handling: No checksums, signatures, pinned revisions, or authentication mechanisms are applied when loading datasets, models, or external resources such as word vectors or Elasticsearch data.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool like Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples in any of the visible data preparation code paths.
No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model checkpoints via agent.load_model() with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading the serialized weights.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor defense mechanisms such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or robustness stress tests are referenced anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics are computed (BLEU, Distinct, embedding-based, IR metrics), there is no held-out test set isolation enforcement, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or other mechanisms to protect against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path loads a dataset and passes it directly to agent.test_model() with no shape, range, or schema validation of inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: The test_model() call result is stored in test_loss with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation visible in the code.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the pipeline uses LLM/generative models (GPT2, LCCC, etc.), there is no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, output content moderation, or jailbreak detection implemented in the visible inference code.
